checks.name: 01_hourly_nested_vs_join
checks.description: 等价的嵌套相关子查询与 JOIN 预聚改写：小时均温结果一致（oracle 核对）

checks.name: 02_set_query_order_swapped
checks.description: UNION ALL 分支顺序对调：忽略返回顺序，多重集合一致（oracle 核对）

checks.name: 03_row_duplicated
checks.description: 新查询错误复制一行：重复行数对不上，指出多重集合差异（oracle 核对）

checks.name: 04_row_deleted
checks.description: 新查询错误删除一行：左侧剩余 1 行（oracle 核对）

checks.name: 05_tolerance_greedy_trap
checks.description: 重复键+容差：贪心逐行最近配对会失败，一对一最大匹配可完整配上（oracle 核对）

checks.name: 06_per_column_matches_whole_row_not
checks.description: a 列、b 列各自都能配上，整行却没有一对相同：必须判差异（oracle 核对）

checks.name: 07_exact_huge_integer_and_decimal
checks.description: HUGEINT 大整数与高精度 DECIMAL 精确比较，不经过 float（oracle 核对）

checks.name: 08_special_floats
checks.description: NaN/±Inf/NULL 混合，同值集合换顺序：特殊值按语义各自相等（oracle 核对）

checks.name: 09_special_float_changed
checks.description: 多引入一个 NaN：NaN 不与有限数/NULL 相等，判差异

checks.name: 10_null_key_groups
checks.description: NULL 业务键正常成组，两条 NULL 键重复行按多重集合配对（oracle 核对）

checks.name: 11_both_empty
checks.description: 两边都返回空结果：空多重集合相等，空结果不被当成豁免（oracle 核对）

checks.name: 12_empty_vs_nonempty
checks.description: 空结果对凭空多出的一行：判差异，右侧剩余 1 行

checks.name: 13_tolerance_at_threshold_exact
checks.description: DECIMAL 差值恰好等于阈值 a：|0.10| = 0.10，边界包含，判相同
checks.old_sql: SELECT 'z' AS k, CAST(1.00 AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS x
checks.new_sql: SELECT 'z' AS k, CAST(1.10 AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS x

checks.name: 14_tolerance_just_over_threshold
checks.description: DECIMAL 差值超出阈值 0.001：判差异
checks.old_sql: SELECT 'z' AS k, CAST(1.000 AS DECIMAL(10,3)) AS x
checks.new_sql: SELECT 'z' AS k, CAST(1.101 AS DECIMAL(10,3)) AS x

checks.name: 15_relative_tolerance_boundary
checks.description: 纯相对容差边界：r*max=0.10，差值 0.10 恰好满足
checks.old_sql: SELECT 'z' AS k, CAST(100.00 AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS x
checks.new_sql: SELECT 'z' AS k, CAST(100.10 AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS x

checks.name: 16_no_keys_whole_table_one_group
checks.description: 不指定业务键：整张结果当一个组做最大匹配（oracle 核对）
checks.old_sql: SELECT sensor_id, temperature FROM sensor_readings WHERE status = 'OK'
checks.new_sql: SELECT sensor_id, temperature FROM sensor_readings WHERE status = 'OK' ORDER BY temperature DESC

checks.name: 17_schema_signature_mismatch
checks.description: 列名不同（label vs name）：列结构不符，作为检查错误而非数据差异

checks.name: 18_duplicate_output_column
checks.description: 新侧输出重名列：明确拒绝

checks.name: 19_unknown_tolerance_column
checks.description: 容差列在输出中不存在：找不到的规则列明确拒绝

checks.name: 20_unknown_key_column
checks.description: 键列在输出中不存在：找不到的键列明确拒绝

checks.name: 21_write_hidden_in_cte
checks.description: UPDATE 藏在 WITH CTE 体内：静态护栏拒绝，不靠开头判断

checks.name: 22_external_file_table_function
checks.description: read_csv_auto 读外部文件：拒绝

checks.name: 23_nondeterministic_random
checks.description: random() 每次运行会变：拒绝

checks.name: 24_multiple_statements
checks.description: SELECT 后跟 DELETE 的多语句：整体拒绝

checks.name: 25_runtime_query_error_continues
checks.description: 查询引用不存在的表：执行错误与数据差异分开，且后续检查继续

checks.name: 26_last_check_still_runs_after_error
checks.description: 上一项执行报错后，本项仍正常运行并通过（证明逐项隔离）
